"'$packet=Get-Content .temp/prepare.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String
$op=(Get-Content .temp/operation-id.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).id
$check=Get-Content ".nyssaai/daily-tasks/operations/$op.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String
if(Test-Path $packet.current.path){throw '"'Destination unexpectedly exists'}
if((Get-FileHash "'$packet.previous.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -ne $packet.previous.sha256){throw '"'Source changed'}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("'$packet.current.path,$check.proposedContent,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
if((Get-FileHash $packet.current.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -ne $check.files[0].after){throw '"'Destination hash mismatch'}
@{vaultRoot="'$packet.context.vaultRoot} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content .temp/invalidate-input.json
node $cli invalidate-project-index --input "$PWD/.temp/invalidate-input.json"
$time=Get-Content .temp/activity-time.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String
if($check.event.activity_at -cne $time.activity_at -or $check.event.recorded_at -cne $time.recorded_at){throw '"'Timestamp mismatch'}
node "'$cli log-append --input "$PWD/.temp/log-input.json"
@{projectsRoot=$packet.context.projectsRoot;action='"'selection-carry-forward'} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content .temp/query-input.json
node "'$cli log-query --input "$PWD/.temp/query-input.json" | Tee-Object -FilePath .temp/query-result.json
node $cli planning-prepare --input "$PWD/.temp/prepare-input.json" | Set-Content .temp/after-prepare.json
Get-Content .temp/query-result.json'
